plain: Of fair exchange, where each side gives equal value for what it gets.

webster.text: Relative to exchange; interchangeable; mutually passing from one to another; as commutative justice, justice which is mutually done and received, between men in society.

example.quote: produced a decay of patriotism, and the love of commutative justice ;
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, Massachusetts Convention, Hon. Mr. TURNER, January 17, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
